verdict.line: You lose if he lands a Flash-R knockup while your Q is down; you win if you force all-ins before level 6 or punish his cooldowns after a whiffed engage.

brief.thesis: Garen's Perseverance sustain and Decisive Strike's silence let him match Malphite's poke, but the entire lane pivots on Unstoppable Force: once Malphite hits 6 he owns a 1000-range engage that neither champion can out-scale around, which is exactly why the measured 49.8% win rate over 2055 games sits dead even rather than favoring either side.

theirWindow.when: Level 6+ with R and Flash both up
theirWindow.what: He can Seismic Shard to slow you, Flash or walk into Unstoppable Force range for a knock-up, then follow with Ground Slam's attack-speed reduction and Brutal Strikes' armor/AD buff. Play back from unwarded flanks and don't commit to trades without Decisive Strike available to silence and break the slow.

yourWindow.when: When his Q and R are both down
yourWindow.what: Shove in and all-in immediately: Decisive Strike's silence cancels his Ground Slam or Brutal Strikes activation, and with no slow or knock-up available he can't disengage or punish your commit.

start.why: Flat damage reduction and the passive proc blunt repeated Seismic Shard pokes while you walk up, and it stacks with Perseverance to keep you topped off between trades.

boots.why: The attack speed lets you land more autos inside Judgment's spin duration and during post-silence all-ins, where raw DPS matters more than Armor.

core.why: The active's slow and gap-close let you close the distance his longer-range Q keeps open and stick through his Seismic Shard slow.
Sustained attack speed keeps your DPS up while his Granite Shield recharges between your engages, so extended trades favor you.
Grievous Wounds cuts through the sustain his Granite Shield passive provides, denying him free damage absorption over the course of a fight.

situational.when: the game drags into mid-game and you need more stick for repeated engages rather than a burst spike
he's stacking armor through Brutal Strikes and you need to shred it to keep your autos and Judgment relevant
you want extra mobility to force the pre-6 all-in window before his Unstoppable Force comes online

runes.keystoneWhy: Repeated autos and Judgment spins during extended trades stack Conqueror into healing that offsets his Seismic Shard poke and Ground Slam chip damage, turning drawn-out fights in your favor.

summoners.why: Ignite punishes all-ins and secures kills since Demacian Justice starts on a brutal 140-second cooldown, while Flash lets you either dodge or immediately follow up his Unstoppable Force engage.

playing.title: Hold Q for his engage
playing.detail: Save Decisive Strike for the moment he flashes or charges in with Unstoppable Force; the silence shuts down his follow-up Ground Slam or Brutal Strikes, and the move speed burst breaks his Seismic Shard slow.

playing.title: Trade when his shield is cracked
playing.detail: Granite Shield absorbs damage and recharges if he avoids getting hit, so land your Judgment and autos back-to-back rather than letting gaps reset his shield for free.

playing.title: Respect his range before level 6
playing.detail: Seismic Shard's 625 range outreaches your 300/325-range Q and E, so use minions to block it or wait out its 8-second cooldown before stepping up to trade.

playing.title: Force fights at levels 3-5
playing.detail: Before his ultimate comes online he has no hard CC besides a slow, so your Perseverance sustain plus Q silence should win extended all-ins in this window.

playing.title: Track his ultimate cooldown after 6
playing.detail: Unstoppable Force runs 130/115/100/80/80 seconds; once he's used it and missed or burned it defensively, shove hard and all-in without fear of a knock-up.

playing.title: Max Judgment first
playing.detail: Following the EQWEEREQEQRQQWW order, prioritizing Judgment drops its cooldown from 13 to 9 seconds, letting you out-trade his flat 7-second Ground Slam in prolonged skirmishes.

playing.title: Use brush to proc your passive
playing.detail: Back into brush when he's not actively poking so Perseverance's health regen kicks in faster, matching the standard read on this matchup.

brief.patchCaveat: The build order, rune pages, summoner spells, and every win-rate or pick-rate figure above come from measured games on the current patch via OP.GG; the mechanical reasoning and trade-timing advice are my own analysis layered on top of that data.
